text.text: Did you know there's a vacation rental in San Diego that has its own disc golf course??
A private course on a beautiful 8-acre property at the base of Iron Mountain
The 19th hole: an '80s-style game pub, complete with a video game museum. Arcade games, NES at the booth and over 100 of the latest Xbox games.
Night play unlocked. After the San Diego courses close, return home and play 24/7 at Boulder Oak.
The Boulder Oak course is exclusive to guests of Mountain Retreat.
Adventure and play right out the back door.
Keep score on UDisc, or use our custom scorecard that emails everyone a beautiful keepsake with round stats.
Views and hiking for days: Iron Mountain and Mount Woodson trails are 3 miles away.
